Description: PS-Speech Interpretation: gives the Speech Personal Status from the Speech Descriptors Object of a speech (the valence, arousal and dominance of the instance I03 of Entity Speech Description). The interpretation is that of MMC-SPE: the (valence, arousal) point is mapped to an Emotion by the quadrants of the affective circumplex, and the dominance to a Social Attitude. A Speech Descriptors Object of another format (a voice embedding) is refused. The model that gives these descriptors (in the instance I03 of Entity Speech Description) is licensed for non-commercial use only (CC-BY-NC-SA-4.0).
